analysisSummary: Retrieved governing July 2026 contract clauses from the selected indexed contract family only. Exceptions supported by retrieved clauses are: carpenter labor rate above the effective straight-time cap; small-tools charge above the 3% cap applied to the supplied eligible direct craft labor base; scissor-lift daily rate above the equipment cap; PPE charge missing the required itemized receipt because it exceeds the evidence threshold; alcohol is excluded from reimbursement; and the invoice/register totals show a non-zero reconciliation variance. No ambiguity blocks these determinations, and no finding was emitted for the scissor-lift evidence because the required evidence types were supplied.
